title: Kaboom Crew Scene Extensions
description: Project-local component types for Kaboom Crew (S082+). Bomb / blast / bomber-stats / bot-brain / round-state primitives live here so engine schemas stay sample-agnostic. The engine recognises this file because it sits at <projectDir>/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json.

deathImpulseComponent.description: S105 KABOOM-DEATH-IMPULSE-COMPONENT. Records the blast that killed this bomber so the engine ragdoll module can apply a direction-aware launch impulse. Written by blast-propagation-system when it flips BomberStats.alive=false; consumed by death-trigger-system (S132) which composes it into the RagdollSpawnRequest. magnitude clamps to 1.8 when chain blasts pile on in the same frame.

hitRecoilComponent.description: S105 KABOOM-HIT-RECOIL-SYSTEM. Brief torso flinch on every blast hit (lethal OR survived). Reserved for the recoil system added in S105-6.

suddenDeathConfigComponent.description: S160 KABOOM-SUDDEN-DEATH. Singleton config on the kaboom.game-state entity. When RoundState.elapsed reaches `triggerAtElapsedS`, the sudden-death-system begins spawning rings of hard blocks from the arena perimeter inward, one ring every `ringIntervalS` seconds. Bombers / bombs / pickups on a cell at spawn time are destroyed (kill credit attributed to SUDDEN_DEATH on bomber kills).

enabled.description: Master switch — set to false via URL flag ?suddenDeath=off for testing or chill-mode.

triggerAtElapsedS.description: RoundState.elapsed value (seconds) at which sudden death first fires. 30 s before the 90 s timeout by default.

ringIntervalS.description: Seconds between successive ring spawns after trigger.

ringWidth.description: Ring thickness in cells. Currently only 1 supported but reserved for future tuning.

suddenDeathStateComponent.description: S160 KABOOM-SUDDEN-DEATH. Runtime state singleton co-located with SuddenDeathConfig on kaboom.game-state. Persists across fixedUpdates so the system knows whether it has triggered yet + how many rings it has already spawned.

activated.description: Set to true the first tick RoundState.elapsed crosses triggerAtElapsedS.

activatedAt.description: Snapshot of RoundState.elapsed at activation. Used to schedule successive ring spawns.

ringsSpawned.description: Count of rings spawned so far. Drives the depth of the next ring (depth = ringsSpawned).

suddenDeathBlockComponent.description: S160 KABOOM-SUDDEN-DEATH. Marker on each spawned wall block so consumers can distinguish it from arena hard-blocks (e.g. for the red emissive accent + the kill-credit path on bomber death).

spawnedAtElapsedS.description: RoundState.elapsed when this block was placed. Cosmetic; useful for animations / debug.

ringIndex.description: 0-based ring depth from the perimeter — 0 is the outermost ring.

accessoryDebrisComponent.description: S162 KABOOM-ACCESSORY-DETACH. Stamped on accessory entities that detached from a dying bomber. The accessory-detach system advances Transform.position using vx/vy/vz each tick, applies gravity, and tweens the mesh opacity to 0 in the final fadeMs. On lifetime expiry the entity is removed.

fadeMs.description: Final-window duration (ms) over which the mesh scale tweens to 0.

gravity.description: Vertical gravity in cells/sec² applied to vy each tick.

accessoryDetachFiredComponent.description: S162 KABOOM-ACCESSORY-DETACH. Marker on a bomber root that has already had its accessories detached this death — prevents the accessory-detach system from firing twice if alive flips back and forth on the same death frame.

arenaThemeComponent.description: S171 KABOOM-ARENA-THEMES MVP (GDP-2026-05-28-013). Singleton co-located on the kaboom.game-state entity. Identifies which visual theme should be applied to the active arena at scene-load. The arena-theme-apply-system reads themeKey, looks up the matching palette in examples/kaboom-crew/src/themes/theme-table.ts, and writes MeshRenderer.color on the floor entity. URL flag ?theme=warehouse|factory|dock|lab|bunker overrides scene defaults; default-arena→theme mapping lives in ARENA_DEFAULT_THEME alongside the theme table. v1 only re-tints the floor; lighting + block palette re-tinting is deferred.

themeKey.description: Which of the 5 registered themes to apply. Defaults to 'warehouse' when the component is absent or carries an unknown key.

floorTerrainComponent.description: S176 KABOOM-FLOOR-WANG-TILES MVP (GDP-2026-05-28-012). Tags a per-cell floor overlay entity with its terrain family. v1 ships two families: 'floor' (the default flat-plate backdrop — cells with this family typically have NO overlay entity at all; the single stretched-box floor in the scene renders them) and 'grass' (a thin overlay slab with procedural green vertex-paint variants resolved through the Wang autotile module). The remaining 3 families from the GDP (path / stone / dirt) plus the WallShadow secondary Wang layer + per-cell sub-variant random pick + theme-aware palette integration are OUT OF SCOPE this sprint — they land in follow-up sprints. The scene's optional top-level `terrainmap?: string[][]` field bulk-authors which cells become non-default; the bootstrap reads it and spawns per-cell overlay entities only for non-'floor' cells.

family.description: Terrain family. 'floor' is the default backdrop (no overlay entity needed). 'grass' spawns a thin overlay slab whose Wang variant resolves from neighbouring grass cells.

lootDropDecayComponent.description: S208 KABOOM-LOOT-DROP (GDP-2026-05-30-001). Tags a pickup entity that was spawned by death-pickup-drop-system so the parallel decay system can despawn it after the per-drop lifetime expires (default 30 s). Normal soft-block pickups carry no LootDropDecay and persist until collected.

remainingS.description: Seconds remaining before the pickup despawns. Decay system removes the entity when this reaches 0.

bomberStatsComponent.description: Per-bomber gameplay stats. `maxBombs` caps simultaneous active bombs; `range` is blast distance in cells; `speed` is GridMover speed override; `activeBombs` is the runtime counter. `alive=false` flips on blast hit + locks GridMover. `canKick=true` enables the S100 KABOOM-KICK-POWER-UP mechanic — bombers slide their own bombs forward when walking into them.

canKick.description: S100 KABOOM-KICK-POWER-UP. True after collecting a 'kick' pickup. Enables sliding your own bomb forward when walking into its cell.

remoteDetonateCharges.description: S100 KABOOM-REMOTE-DETONATE-PUP. Each charge converts the NEXT placed bomb into a paused (fuseRemaining=Infinity) bomb that the player triggers manually via the 'remote-detonate' InputAction (or F key). Capped at 3 per bomber.

shield.description: S109 KABOOM-SHIELD-POWER-UP. True after collecting a 'shield' pickup. Absorbs the next lethal blast (alive STAYS true, shield flips to false) and triggers hit-recoil instead of ragdoll. One-shot, binary (no stacking).

pierce.description: S142 KABOOM-PIERCE-BOMB (GDP-2026-05-26-002, gameplay-systems.md §5.3). True after collecting a 'pierce' pickup. The NEXT placed bomb's blast walks through the first soft block in each direction without stopping; second soft block stops it normally. Carried at placement time — bomb-placement-system copies BomberStats.pierce → Bomb.pierce when spawning, so the owner can lose pierce afterwards without stripping the in-flight bomb.

canThrow.description: S144 KABOOM-THROW-GLOVE (GDP-2026-05-26-004). True after collecting a 'throw-glove' pickup. Enables the T-key pickup/throw mechanic: when standing on the bomber's own bomb cell, T picks the bomb up (fuse pauses); while carrying, T throws the bomb 3 cells in the facing direction over obstacles.

bombPass.description: S152 KABOOM-BOMB-PASS (GDP-2026-05-27-007, gameplay-systems.md §5.3). True after collecting a 'bomb-pass' pickup. Lets the bomber walk through their OWN placed bombs (after stepping off). Other bombers' bombs still block this bomber. Movement-only — does NOT grant immunity to blasts. Paired with the S152 baseline that makes bombs solid to bombers (own bomb after step-off; others' bombs always).

dashCooldownRemainingMs.description: S159 KABOOM-DASH (GDP-2026-05-27-014). Cooldown ms remaining before the bomber can dash again. Ticks down per fixedUpdate; reset to 3000 ms when a dash starts.

dashing.description: S159 — true while the bomber is mid-dash arc. Driven by dash-system; other systems may use it to skip damage paths.

dashStartGx.description: S159 — bomber cell at dash start. Mid-arc lerp source.

dashStartGz.description: S159 — bomber cell at dash start. Mid-arc lerp source.

dashElapsedMs.description: S159 — ms since dash start. Lands when ≥ 200.

carryingBombId.description: S144 KABOOM-THROW-GLOVE. Entity id of the bomb the bomber is currently carrying. Set by bomb-pickup-system; cleared by bomb-throw-system on landing or by the death path on owner-death. The input system reads this to branch T-key behaviour between pickup and throw.

bombComponent.description: Live bomb. `fuseRemaining` ticks down each fixedUpdate; at zero the bomb emits a BlastEvent and gets deleted. `range` is the blast distance from the bomb cell. `ownerId` is who placed it (so kill credit + activeBombs decrement land on the right BomberStats).

pierce.description: S142 KABOOM-PIERCE-BOMB. When true the blast walks through the first soft block in each direction; subsequent soft blocks stop it. Carried at placement time from owner's BomberStats.pierce.

carriedBy.description: S144 KABOOM-THROW-GLOVE. When set (entity id of the carrying bomber), the bomb's fuse is paused and the bomb's Transform is parented to the bomber's torso.back socket. bomb-fuse-system skips the fuse decrement while this is present.

airborne.description: S144 KABOOM-THROW-GLOVE. True during the 0.45s arc between a throw and the landing-cell snap. Fuse stays paused while airborne; bomb-throw-system clears it on landing.

airborneRemaining.description: S144 KABOOM-THROW-GLOVE. Seconds remaining in the airborne arc. Decrements per fixedUpdate; on ≤ 0 bomb-throw-system snaps the bomb to its landing cell, restores GridOccupant, clears airborne + airborneRemaining, resumes fuse.

pickupBombRequestComponent.description: S144 KABOOM-THROW-GLOVE. Transient input request written by player-input-system when T fires for a bomber standing on their own bomb cell. bomb-pickup-system consumes it the same fixedUpdate.

throwBombRequestComponent.description: S144 KABOOM-THROW-GLOVE. Transient input request written by player-input-system when T fires for a bomber carrying a bomb. bomb-throw-system consumes it the same fixedUpdate.

dashRequestComponent.description: S159 KABOOM-DASH (GDP-2026-05-27-014). Transient input request written by player-input-system when Shift + direction fires. dash-system consumes + removes the same fixedUpdate. dx/dz pick a cardinal direction (-1/0/1, only one non-zero).

conveyorBeltComponent.description: S146 KABOOM-CONVEYOR-BELT (GDP-2026-05-26-003, gameplay-systems.md §11). Marks a grid cell as a belt that pushes bombers + bombs along (directionDx, directionDz) every speedMs ms. Belts are arena fixtures — immune to blasts.

elapsedMs.description: Internal: ms accumulated since the last push. Reset by the belt system when the threshold fires.

warpHoleComponent.description: S149 KABOOM-WARP-HOLE (GDP-2026-05-27-004, gameplay-systems.md §11). Marks a grid cell as one end of a warp pair. Bombers and bombs entering this cell are teleported to the partner cell (same pairId, opposite role) on the next fixedUpdate, with a 300 ms per-pair cooldown to prevent infinite ping-pong.

pairId.description: Identifier shared between the two cells of a warp pair.

role.description: Which end of the pair this cell represents.

lastWarpAt.description: Internal: last warp time in seconds since the system started. Both ends of a pair carry the same value; updated by warp-hole-system on every successful warp.

pressurePlateComponent.description: S151 KABOOM-PRESSURE-PLATE (GDP-2026-05-27-006, gameplay-systems.md §11). Third hazard module after Conveyor Belt + Warp Hole. Marks a grid cell as a trigger: when any alive bomber or active bomb is on the cell, the configured action fires (with per-plate cooldown). S151 ships the 'spawn-bomb' triggerAction only — 'open-gate' and 'arena-event' are deferred to follow-up sprints per sprint notes.

plateId.description: Unique identifier for ordering tie-breaks + future cross-plate references.

triggerAction.description: Action fired on occupancy. v1 ships spawn-bomb only; future sprints extend the enum with open-gate + arena-event.

cooldownMs.description: Minimum ms between successive triggers on the same plate. Default 1000 ms.

actionPayload.description: Action-specific config. For spawn-bomb: { spawnGx, spawnGz, range?, fuseS? }. Authored as untyped JSON; pressure-plate-system narrows by triggerAction.

lastTriggerAt.description: Internal: last trigger time in seconds since the system started. Maintained by pressure-plate-system.

placeBombRequestComponent.description: Transient input request. PlayerInputSystem + BotAISystem write this on the bomber entity; BombPlacementSystem consumes + removes it the same frame.

remoteDetonateRequestComponent.description: S100 KABOOM-REMOTE-DETONATE-PUP. Transient input request written on a player when they press F (or the 'remote-detonate' InputAction is injected). BombFuseSystem reads it: for every Bomb owned by this player with fuseRemaining=Infinity (paused), set fuseRemaining=0 so they all detonate this fixedUpdate. Component is removed after handling.

blastEventComponent.description: Transient event written by BombFuseSystem when a bomb detonates. BlastPropagationSystem consumes + removes it the same frame.

pierce.description: S142 KABOOM-PIERCE-BOMB. Copied from the detonating Bomb.pierce. When true, blast-propagation walks through the first soft block in each direction (still destroying it) before stopping on a normal block.

blastTileComponent.description: Short-lived visual marker on a blast cell. Tween system fades it out + a `lifetimeRemaining` timer deletes the entity when zero. Damages bombers that share the cell while alive.

botBrainComponent.description: Bot AI tuning + scratch state. `aggression` 0..1 drives the flee-vs-bomb tradeoff; `nextDecisionIn` is a fixed-update countdown to the bot's next direction decision; `lastDecision` caches the chosen cardinal so we can prefer continuing instead of zigzagging.

personality.description: S100 KABOOM-BOT-PERSONALITY-VARIANTS. 'hunter' (default) chases the nearest player + bombs when adjacent to soft blocks. 'coward' has no chase goal + bombs more eagerly when threatened (defensive shield). 'miner' chases soft blocks AND pickups, ignores the player unless in path; bombs more eagerly toward soft blocks.

roundStateComponent.description: Singleton round state. RoundResolveSystem flips `phase` to 'won' / 'lost' / 'draw' when ≤ 1 bombers remain alive. `elapsed` is wall-clock seconds since the round started. `roundNumber` increments on every (re)start so the HUD can show 'Round N'. `tally` carries the player-vs-bot win/loss/draw count across restarts; RoundResolveSystem bumps the right field when the phase resolves. Both `roundNumber` and `tally` are seeded by the bootstrap on restart so they survive the scene.load wipe.

timeLimit.description: S85 KABOOM-ROUND-TIMER. Seconds before the round auto-draws when both bombers are still alive. 0 / omitted disables.

matchTarget.description: S87 KABOOM-MATCH-BEST-OF-5. Number of decisive round wins that ends the match. Default best-of-3. Mirror of MatchState.target — kept on RoundState for backward compatibility with code that reads it directly.

matchPhase.description: S87 KABOOM-MATCH-BEST-OF-5 (legacy). Use MatchState.phase as the source of truth; this field is kept on RoundState as a derived mirror for backward compatibility with code that reads it directly.

matchStateComponent.description: S115 KABOOM-MATCH-STRUCTURE. Singleton match state, mirrors RoundState's pattern. A 'match' = best-of-`target` decisive rounds (default 3). RoundResolveSystem flips `phase` to 'resolved' when max(tally.player, tally.bot) reaches `target`; after a longer pause the system fires onRestart, the bootstrap resets the tally, bumps matchNumber, and sets phase back to 'playing'.

target.description: Number of decisive round wins to end the match. URL `?matchTarget=N` overrides. 1 = single round, 3 = best-of-3 (default), 5 = best-of-5.

matchNumber.description: Increments each match. Survives auto-restart via the bootstrap restartScene re-seed.

lastMatchWinner.description: Set when phase flips to 'resolved'. Drives the centre banner copy.

resolvedAt.description: RoundState.elapsed value at the moment the match resolved. The auto-restart timer reads this to extend the pause from 3s to 7s.

roundRestartRequestComponent.description: Transient input request. PlayerInputSystem writes this on R key; RoundResolveSystem consumes it + emits a scene.load command.

agentGotoComponent.description: S82 KABOOM-AGENT-CONTROLS. Agent-supplied target cell. AgentGotoSystem reads it each frame and writes GridMover.queuedDirection toward the goal. v0 uses straight-line cardinal preference + GridMover lane-assist; BFS pathfinding is KABOOM-AGENT-PATHFIND.

gamePausedComponent.description: S84 KABOOM-TITLE-SCREEN. Singleton marker. While present on the `kaboom.game-state` entity, BotAISystem + BombFuseSystem + BombPlacementSystem skip their work — the round freezes for the title-screen overlay. Player input still runs (the key-binding lives outside the world) but a queuedDirection without bot AI / bomb fuse / placement progress is a no-op visually.

agentGotoResultComponent.description: S82 KABOOM-AGENT-CONTROLS. Outcome of the last AgentGoto request. Written by AgentGotoSystem when it removes AgentGoto. `arrived` = reached target; `unreachable` = target cell was blocked when the request was issued; `stuck` = entity stopped making progress toward the target for stuckGraceFrames consecutive frames (no path with the v0 straight-line policy). Stays on the entity until the next AgentGoto request overwrites it or the host consumes it.

pickupComponent.description: Power-up item. PickupCollectSystem detects a bomber entering the same grid cell + applies the effect to BomberStats. Kinds: `bomb-up` (+1 maxBombs), `fire-up` (+1 range), `speed-up` (+1 GridMover speed), `kick` (S100 — sets BomberStats.canKick=true), `remote-detonate` (S100 — +1 BomberStats.remoteDetonateCharges, capped at 3), `shield` (S109 — one-shot blast protection: sets BomberStats.shield=true; consumed by the next lethal blast), `pierce` (S142 — sets BomberStats.pierce=true; the next placed bomb's blast walks through the first soft block in each direction), `throw-glove` (S144 — sets BomberStats.canThrow=true; enables T-key pickup/throw of your own bomb).

softBlockDestroyedEventComponent.description: S82 KABOOM-PICKUPS-AND-STATS. Transient event written by BlastPropagationSystem when a soft block is destroyed. PickupSpawnSystem consumes + removes it the same fixedUpdate, rolls a deterministic-by-cell RNG, and may spawn a Pickup at the cleared cell.
